title: Process agent RPC messages
responsibility: Match incoming replies to requests and manage request sending and timeouts.

inputs.name: rpcMessages.state
inputs.description: State with a numeric-ID pending map, event-listener set, and sender callback used while handling replies and notifications. The function assumes these members are usable and does not validate them.

inputs.name: rpcMessages.line
inputs.description: Serialized input line passed to JSON.parse and then treated as a message record. Invalid JSON syntax is ignored; matched replies need a numeric pending ID, notifications need a string method, and parsed null is not guarded.

inputs.name: rpcRequest.state
inputs.description: State containing the pending-request map and sender callback used to register and transmit the new frame. It assumes the map and callback are usable and does not validate them.

inputs.name: rpcRequest.frame
inputs.type: { id: number; method: string; params: unknown }
inputs.description: Object passed to state.send and tracked by its numeric ID until reply or timeout. Its declared fields are id, method, and params; the implementation does not validate them.
inputs.unknownReason: The RPC method determines the schema of params; request tracking relies on the numeric id.

inputs.name: rpcRequest.timeoutMs
inputs.description: Delay in milliseconds passed directly to setTimeout for removal and rejection of this request. The implementation does not validate the value.

outputs.name: rpcMessages
outputs.description: Returns undefined after processing the line. A message with a string method is answered with an unavailable error if it has an id; otherwise it is delivered to listeners.

outputs.name: rpcRequest
outputs.description: Resolves with the matched reply's result without validating its shape; if result is absent, the resolved value is undefined. It rejects on a truthy reply error, timeout, or a thrown value from the sender.

errors.name: CodexRpcError
errors.description: A matched reply with a truthy error causes rpcRequest to reject with an Error whose message is String(error.message ?? 'Codex RPC failed.'). The timeout callback also rejects with CodexRpcError('Codex ' + frame.method + ' timed out.').

errors.name: Sender or callback error
errors.description: If state.send throws while rpcRequest sends the frame, rpcRequest rejects with the same thrown value after removing the pending entry and clearing its timer. In rpcMessages, thrown values from pending callbacks, notification listeners, or the sender answering an incoming request propagate synchronously because those calls are not caught.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: A line whose JSON text parses to null triggers TypeError when rpcMessages reads msg.id; JSON.parse syntax errors are caught and ignored.
